feature: Pengiriman transaksi pembayaran AXS ke URA Payment Gateway (Recon/insertOcmsAxsTxn) untuk rekonsiliasi pembayaran
note: Mirip kebutuhan komunikasi OCMS ke Payment Gateway di OCMS46.4/46.5, tetapi yang dikirim adalah transaksi pembayaran masuk untuk rekonsiliasi, bukan ID/mobile untuk refund PayNow dan tidak ada status refund yang diterima balik. Verdict story tetap Removed.
note_en: Resembles the OCMS-to-Payment-Gateway communication in OCMS46.4/46.5, but what is sent is incoming payment transactions for reconciliation, not an ID/mobile for a PayNow refund, and no refund status is received back. The story verdict stays Removed.

feature: POST /plus-apply-suspension membuat baris ocms_refund_notice (alasan = kode PS) untuk PS-APP/CFA/VST pada notice terbayar dan mengembalikan refundNoticeId ke PLUS
note: Mirip bagian 'menerima permintaan waive notice terbayar dari PLUS' di OCMS46.4. Hanya membuat record refund; tidak ada approval officer atau pengiriman ke Payment Gateway. Mungkin sudah dicakup story PLUS integration di epic lain; belum dicek di luar chunk ini. Tiket terkait: OCMS-DF-2026-075, OCMS-DF-2026-152.
note_en: Resembles the 'receive a waive request for a paid notice from PLUS' part of OCMS46.4. It only creates the refund record; there is no officer approval or sending to Payment Gateway. May already be covered by a PLUS integration story in another epic; not checked outside this chunk. Related tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-075, OCMS-DF-2026-152.
